items.title: Charlie Hamilton Interview, 1965-03-21
items.q: with Peter Bocard, I mean, I think Barry Martin.

ctx.x: Yeah, it'd be nice to make them those trips to England sometimes, just to see the rest of the world, as long as you're not tied down here.
And I have made some recordings too for, what you call it, over there in England, with Peter Bocard, I mean, I think Barry Martin.
Barry Martin. Yeah, he recorded me.
